hero.description:
A picture of the Upper Globe pub on Toller Lane in Bradford. It was attacked during the Bradford Riots in 2001, and has since laid disused.
MGSpiller 13:12, 25 June 2006 (UTC)

This is untrue, it was damaged in the Manningham riots which were held over two days in 1995. There was a band playing there that evening who still carried on playing to scared patrons, themselves in fear but they did their best to carry on. This pub has stood empty since then. They kept patrons locked inside for their safety despite the windows being smashed, but it was less safe for them to leave.
